text: The field of astronomy encompasses a vast array of scientific disciplines, from the study of celestial objects to the detection of gravitational waves. Among its most fascinating phenomena is the telescope, a device that has revolutionized human understanding of the universe. Telescopes are not only essential for observing distant stars and planets but have also been instrumental in revealing the formation of nebulae, which are vast interstellar clouds of gas and dust. The study of nebulae is crucial for understanding the processes that shape the formation of galaxies, and the discovery of these celestial bodies has opened up new avenues for research.
